value:
Executable packs (pack format shipping exec entries) REJECTED 2026-05-12 — filed as #116, closed same day. Skills already distribute procedural ops with bundled scripts; MCPs distribute structured tools; shell aliases/direnv beat the CLI-ergonomics angle. No differentiation. Text packs (#115) STAY — Reverie's slot is "what the agent knows before it acts," which skills/MCPs don't fill.

REVISIT ONLY IF: the agent-agnostic angle (project.goals #4) becomes pressing AND other ecosystems (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) still lack a skills equivalent — then an exec-pack channel would be the only cross-agent procedural-distribution surface. That's a v2.x scope reframe, not an MVP feature.

DON'T refile as a "lite" / "own-machine-only" / "wraps-one-command" variant — shell aliases beat all three.
